title: Custom tints
description: Paper White 2's own field tints (docs/paperwhite2/plugins.md, Custom tints): field weathers WEATHER_CUSTOM_TINT_1 to WEATHER_CUSTOM_TINT_12 (include/system/zone_weather.h), the list's first tint the first slot. A tint is the DS's fog in its own colour: flat covers every depth alike, a screen fade; fog thickens with distance. tools/paperwhite2/field_tints.py checks the file and writes it into paperwhite2/field_tints_config.h for src/paperwhite2/ov036/paperwhite2_field_tint.c; a slot past the list's end is clear.

tints.description: The tints, slot 1 first: the order is the weathers', so moving one changes every run, room and calendar that names its weather

name.description: What the tint is, for people: the debug menu shows only its slot (Custom tint 1 to 12)

color.description: Red, green and blue from 0 to 255; the DS shows 5 bits an axis, so the game rounds each to the nearest of 32 levels

strength.description: How much of the colour covers the map at its thickest, in percent: flat, everywhere; fog, far off, with about half of that at the player (at the default fog_shift and fog_offset)

style.description: flat: every depth the same, so the whole map and the sky gaps fade alike; fog: thickens with distance from the camera, like the rain's fog, mapped to each map's camera

fog_shift.description: fog only: the fog's slope (the hardware's shift, on a normal town's camera); one more halves the distance it takes to thicken. 8 when left out, the rain's

fog_offset.description: fog only: the depth where the fog starts, on a normal town's camera, whose player is at depth 32661: lower starts it nearer. 32597 when left out, which puts the player about half way into it
